Later Delete is not made best effort by this acceptance: teardown.rs:310-420 retains WholeSession marker sweeping without a terminal and enumerates historical tab/launch scopes, and 531-561 propagates failed process sweep or unconfirmed host shutdown before row removal. No concrete distinct wrong-target or later-unconfirmed-Delete route was established from this assigned deletion. Suggested bucket: highest (loss of user-owned processes/work). Could-be-highest: yes. Confidence: confirmed source and contract, no execution. proposed_drop: SPEC.md Terminal experience, 3003-3017 explicitly says "This release ends them: the first time a host's supervisor of this release starts, it ends that tmux server, and with it everything that still ran in an old terminal, without needing a tmux program." It preserves an ended agent's outcome but says "its terminal's last screen, which lived in the server, is gone; old tabs are closed." The known failed-termination residual is also explicitly accepted there: "A failure to end the server or to stop what ran there is logged and never stops the supervisor from starting; those sessions are treated as ended all the same, accepting that a Restart could then start a second agent beside one still running." SPEC_impl.md Terminal substrate: private tmux server specifies the same boundaries and budget. possible_cover: none beyond these exact specification acceptances; no forbidden coverage sources searched. Caveats: the known duplicate-after-Restart residual is preserved here as related provenance, not claimed as a new discovery. This acceptance does not excuse misleading update guidance, missing warnings, wrong-target termination or unconfirmed Delete; no concrete separate route for those arose from the assigned test deletion. No proposed drop has been accepted; independent highest-bucket checking remains required.

event.summary: excerpt sanitizer coverage survives removal of tmux reducer tests
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. Original considered consequence preserved: deleting the old launch-excerpt reducer and regression tests could remove escaping or size bounds for failure text displayed to users, potentially permitting presentation injection. TLDR: This deletion retains a test that distinguishes the unsafe behavior from the required escaping and bound. Assigned patch 00951-005.patch:744-783 deletes the old streaming reducer test; replacement service/launch_artifacts.rs:804-840 calls the real screen reducer with six nonblank lines followed by 20,000 blank rows, asserts exactly five joined lines and the exact expected string containing literal escaped bidi/control notation, and separately passes 1,000 repeated multibyte-plus-bidi sequences and asserts the post-escaping 500-byte bound and absence of unsafe characters. The production reducer at 96-123 implements the same contract. SPEC.md Terminal experience, 2889-2895 requires five nonblank lines, 500 UTF-8 bytes and unsafe-character escaping. Could-be-highest: yes for that original consequence; preserve for independent review. event.summary: new hosts replace tmux excerpt generation fences
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: Considered whether removing reused-pane excerpt tests lets a failed new launch quote the preceding conversation or tmux's exit banner. Source refutation: assigned deletion packet 00951-005.patch:825-1336 tests fresh/reused tmux panes, numeric history/height, resize/banner exclusion and old generation fences. At the replacement revision launch_artifacts.rs:63-74 reads only the entry's current terminal, requires Owned dead evidence and quotes its visible screen. host_restart.rs:237-256 starts a new host for the new generation, seeded by restart_seed at 418-464.
